setup.baseline: A fixed neutral race and wizard state.
setup.variable: One trait, range or efficiency setting at a time.

procedure: Measure the balance delta for every trait and every field-range/efficiency setting using the operator scenario template.
Test every pair of traits and record whether either disables the other or changes its cost.
Test all 24 traits against each research-cost choice and each immunity.
Record results as observed values with at least three trials where UI behavior is ambiguous.
Do not infer a formula from a single point sample.
unresolved: No numeric point values, cost formula, exclusion matrix or full valid-combination set is recovered.
The help does not provide the point table.
No original-game execution or disassembly was performed in PR2.
notes: This is a gap scenario. It defines the measurements required to replace unknown values; it does not assert any point cost.
